findings.title: Recurring cancellation no longer waits for calendar deletions
findings.body: This `forEach` callback now suspends at `await getCalendar`, but `forEach` does not wait for async callbacks. The handler can reach `Promise.all(apiDeletes)` at line 652 while `apiDeletes` is still empty, then return success before any recurring calendar events are deleted. If the process exits or the import/deletion fails, the external events remain even though the bookings are cancelled.

findings.title: All app imports start eagerly when the store is loaded
findings.body: Each `import()` is executed while this object is constructed, so loading the app-store module immediately starts imports for every integration, even when the caller needs only one app. Since common paths import the store, this still loads all provider modules and incurs their startup and memory costs rather than loading only the requested app.
